title: Server: serve static web client files
description: Add static file serving to the Axum server. Serve client/dist/ at / (root). GET / returns index.html. GET /game/{room_id} returns game.html. All other static assets (JS, CSS) served from /assets/. tower-http ServeDir handles this. When client/dist/ doesn't exist, / returns a JSON message pointing to /rooms and /games API endpoints instead. Zero config — same binary serves both API and UI.
